properties.title: Wildberries warehouse destroyed, Tambov Oblast
properties.summary: Wildberries logistics center in Kotovsk completely gutted by Ukrainian drone strike. Russian PM Mishustin issued emergency tax relief for affected sellers.

properties.title: Amur Gas Chemical Complex fire - 7 dead
properties.summary: Fire at under-construction AGCC killed 6 Chinese and 1 Russian worker. 9 Chinese workers missing. Joint Russia-China energy infrastructure project.

properties.title: Russian strike on Chernihiv
properties.summary: Russian forces struck a warehouse in Chernihiv for the second time; 4 wounded, people may be under rubble.

properties.title: Russian strike on Ukraine-Moldova border crossing
properties.summary: Russia struck a border crossing on the Ukrainian-Moldovan border, raising cross-border economic disruption concerns.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone strikes Lipetsk Oblast - 2 killed
properties.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a private residence in Lipetsk Oblast, killing 2 people.

properties.title: FIRMS thermal anomaly cluster - Crimea
properties.summary: Multiple VIIRS FIRMS thermal anomalies (17.68 MW, 11.08 MW, 10.51 MW, 4.97 MW) detected in Crimea near 44.53N, 34.13E. Resolution: 375m.

properties.title: M5.5 earthquake - south of Fiji Islands
properties.summary: Magnitude 5.5 earthquake south of the Fiji Islands, depth 528 km (deep, low surface damage risk).

properties.title: M5.0 earthquake - Ruteng, Indonesia
properties.summary: Magnitude 5.0, depth 10 km, 54 km NNE of Ruteng, Flores, Indonesia.

properties.title: M7.4 earthquake - Colombia (GDACS Red)
properties.summary: GDACS Red Alert earthquake M7.4 in Colombia, depth 110 km. (Aug 10, most recent GDACS Red event.)

properties.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption (Iran blockade)
properties.summary: US-Iran ceasefire holding but Strait of Hormuz traffic remains disrupted. Polymarket: 10% chance of return to normal by Sept 30.

properties.title: CIA Director Ratcliff visits Moscow
properties.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliff made unannounced visit to Moscow — first since the large-scale war began. Kremlin confirmed 'intelligence contacts'. Ratcliff arrived via C-17 from Latvia.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone strikes Novoshakhtinsk (Rostov Oblast)
properties.summary: Drone raid reported in Novoshakhtinsk, Rostov Oblast, Russia.
